updates.title: [EDI/BRE] EDI ↔ Pricing — enforcement + negotiatedFinalPrice path
updates.summary: Pricing onboarding session aligned EDI price tolerance as zona-defined adjustment within a band (not promotions). Leading candidate: BRE validates via enforcement (max-min price) then passes negotiatedFinalPrice to simulation/order creation — taxes and charges stay on catalog base price. Flex parallel exists but upward adjustments need price adjustment, not discount. negotiatedFinalPrice delivered in Q2.
decisions: EDI tolerance is price adjustment within a zona band — order-level, not permanent catalog update
Leading path: enforcement validation → negotiatedFinalPrice on order creation without full tax/charge recalculation
Premise to validate: small deviations (cents) acceptable with taxes/charges on catalog base
No Flex deal prerequisite required for negotiatedFinalPrice enforcement
actionItems: Gabriel Gomes: send simulation request example with negotiatedFinalPrice
Rafael Rhormens: study enforcement + simulation integration for BRE order creation
Renan: confirm with MX/AR zonas that not recalculating taxes on small deviations is acceptable
Gabriel Gomes: share menu-order documentation for simulation parameters BRE can use

updates.title: México — pack size, inforecord, and price condition classes
updates.summary: Deep discovery with Carlos Pallares on México SAP parametrization: pack size drives price conversion only; inforecord (per SKU + solicitante) drives quantity conversion; condition classes define which price type retailers send. BEES catalog lacks per-client pack/inforecord variation — Barrilito example shows uniform 24 units for all clients. EAN/UPC epic proceeds; qty + price validation blocked until architecture decision.
decisions: Pack size and inforecord are separate dimensions — must not be conflated
Price formula: retailer_unit_price × pack_size_factor vs BEES price per box
Quantity formula: retailer_qty × inforecord_factor = boxes — ignore retailer UOM alone
Condition classes configured at solicitante level (8 OXXO parents), not chain level
Solicitante is not mapped to DDC/plant in México model
actionItems: Carlos Pallares: email SAP tables, clases de condición definitions, and worked examples
Renan: draft HLR for quantity conversion and price comparison
Renan + Rhormens: architecture session incorporating packaging rules alongside EAN HLS

updates.title: [MX] EDI/BRE Business Rules Q&A — delivery models, POC ID, UPC mapping, tax, switch config
updates.summary: Joint session with Karla Mendoza and Jason Marroquin to validate Mexico-specific business rules for the EDI validator. Covered delivery type logic (T2/T4/SEDIS), POC identification method, UPC→SKU mapping complexity, tax zone validation (8% vs 16%), switch on/off configuration granularity, the ops dashboard concept (Accepted / Needs Attention / Blocked), and integration scope with Pegaso/SAP.
decisions: T4 (retailer-pickup) and SEDIS orders are exempt from max order quantity, min order quantity, and max adjustment rules
POC identification will use RFC + internal SAP store/vendor ID — not provider code, not GLN
GLN adoption as primary identifier not pursued due to retailer-change complexity
UPCs are the universal product identifier across all Mexican retailers in EDI orders
MOQ switch on/off granularity: Sales Office + Retailer composite key (not sales center, no per-store blacklist)
Order hold time for blocked orders: ~2–3 days maximum (to be confirmed with Alfredo in operations)
Front-end admin configuration for hold time is out of scope for 2026 — changes via ticket/code initially
UPC-SKU matching (Z-pack table) will be handled via manual CSV import into BEES as first step — no new SAP integration required immediately
Only Extra currently has the T4 origin_type field populated; OXXO T4 orders handled manually by operations staff

updates.title: HLR complete — BEESEDI-48947 UPC Matching (L2 stories written)
updates.summary: The High Level Requirements document for BEESEDI-48947 (UPC/EAN Matching) was finalized today with 9 implementation user stories (BEESEDI-52094..52102). The HLR covers strict and relaxed matching paths, POC-level mapping CRUD, catalog-first lookup with fallback to mapping layer, ambiguous match handling with curation hold, retailer blacklist, retry logic, and a full structured logging taxonomy. BEESEDI-48947 is now in Ready for High Level Solution and the epic is unblocked for development estimation.
decisions: Strict path: per-line rejection of unmatched lines; full-order rejection if zero matches
Relaxed path: toggle-disabled or retailer-blacklisted retailers skip UPC matching entirely
Ambiguous matches held until curation resolves or order expiration — no arbitrary selection
Toggle key for this rule: SKU_MATCHING, following the existing BRE toggle infrastructure pattern
Catalog lookup always takes priority over POC mapping — mapping cannot override a catalog match
actionItems: Engineering: estimate and plan stories BEESEDI-52094..52102 for sprint scheduling
Architecture: add component diagrams to the HLR (toggle layer, resolution pipeline, mapping store, curation hold)
Renan: confirm curation expiration mechanism with architecture (scheduled job vs. event-driven)

updates.title: 3P EDI discovery kicked off — BEES as EDI broker for L'Oréal BR
updates.summary: Discovery page for '[EDI/BRE] BEES EDI for 3P Orders' published to BLK Confluence. The initiative targets enabling BEES as an EDI broker for 3P principals, starting with L'Oréal BR pharmacy banners (DPC, Panpharma/GSC, Solfarma, RealDec) via Pharmalink, Cosmos, and Neogrid. GMV opportunity: USD 60M+ currently disconnected from BEES. Key insight: 88 of 93 Droga Leste stores order via EDI daily; Drogaria Carrefour has 19 years of fully EDI-based ordering. The solution will reuse and extend the existing EDI Order Validator MVP infrastructure built for 1P (MX/AR).
decisions: L'Oréal BR is the pilot — DPC, Panpharma/GSC, Solfarma, RealDec as first partners
Pharmalink is the priority broker; Cosmos and Neogrid to follow
Parallel run strategy during pilot: BEES + existing broker simultaneously until success gates are met
Reuse link-edi-orders-orchestrator service and extend for 3P vendor configurations
Out of scope for this phase: decommissioning legacy brokers, pricing recalculation, non-Brazil markets
actionItems: Renan: align on product owner and engineering manager for 3P EDI discovery
